recordline1_constants.note: Identical to scripts/build_edge_site.py (model RecordLine-1). Assumptions, not official values — flagged E-01.

_meta.engine_v0_formula: POSS = pace_home + pace_away - league_pace; PTS = (OffRtg_team * DefRtg_opp / league_OffRtg) * POSS / 100; TOTAL = PTS_home + PTS_away; SPREAD = PTS_home - PTS_away; HCA NOT applied (flagged)
_meta.b2b_derivation: Complete captured slates 2026-11-13 (9 games, official calendar strip) through 2026-11-17. b2b=True only when the team appears on the immediately preceding captured slate; b2b=False is derivable (not inferred) because the preceding slates are complete; exact rest_days only when the previous appearance is captured.
integrity_gates_passed: 27 window games; per-date counts match the official calendar strip (5/9/8/5) and the 11/13 slate (9)
all captured records match teams_advanced (w, l, gp) — two independent official captures agree
every row carries an official NBA source link; hosts allow-listed
flags: E-01: RecordLine-1 constants (HCA 2.5, K 35, SIGMA 11, smoothing 3/6, gate 3.0) are project assumptions, not official values.
Records were captured before any 2026-11-13 game finished (two were LIVE); inputs are therefore through 11/12 games.
Injury designations for 11/14 games are from the 11/13 07:30 PM ET edition; five teams read NOT YET SUBMITTED; later window dates have no reports yet.
POR@MIN appears on both 11/16 and 11/17 per the official schedule (ids 0022600250 / 0022600254) — transcribed verbatim; the 11/17 game is a B2B for both teams.

meta.title: NBA official injury report — games of 2026-11-14, as first designated in the 11/13/26 07:30 PM ET edition
meta.reporting_rules: Teams must report by 5 p.m. local time the day before a game (other than the second day of a back-to-back); second-day-of-back-to-back reports by 1 p.m. local on game day; game-day reports between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m. local (8-10 a.m. for tip-offs 5 p.m. or earlier). Reports update continually throughout the day. Source: https://official.nba.com/nba-injury-report-2026-27-season/
meta.extraction_note: The PDF-to-text extraction loses the Team cell on rows that begin a new PDF page (known defect, same as data/injury_report_2026_11_13.json). Ten rows lost the team cell; each was attributed only after confirmation against the team's official roster page (team_source='roster' with team_source_url). No row was attributed by inference from context.
meta.coverage_note: This edition covers 2026-11-14 games only. Five teams read NOT YET SUBMITTED at capture: New Orleans, Cleveland, Memphis, Chicago, Miami. No designations exist for 2026-11-15/16/17 games yet (deadlines not reached).
